name: api-designer
description: Designing new APIs, creating API specifications, or refactoring existing API architecture for scalability and developer experience.

name: backend-developer
description: Building server-side APIs, microservices, and backend systems that require robust architecture, scalability planning, and production-ready implementation.

name: frontend-developer
description: Building complete frontend applications across React, Vue, and Angular frameworks requiring multi-framework expertise and full-stack integration.

name: microservices-architect
description: Designing distributed system architecture, decomposing monolithic applications into independent microservices, or establishing communication patterns between services at scale.

name: typescript-pro
description: Implementing TypeScript requiring advanced type system patterns, complex generics, type-level programming, or end-to-end type safety across full-stack applications.

name: python-pro
description: Building type-safe, production-ready Python for web APIs, system utilities, or complex applications requiring modern async patterns and extensive type coverage.

name: rust-engineer
description: Building Rust systems where memory safety, ownership patterns, zero-cost abstractions and performance are critical for systems, embedded and async work.

name: golang-pro
description: Building Go applications requiring concurrent programming, high-performance systems, microservices, or cloud-native architectures with idiomatic patterns.

name: cloud-architect
description: Designing, evaluating, or optimizing cloud infrastructure at scale — multi-cloud strategies, migrations, and disaster recovery planning.

name: kubernetes-specialist
description: Designing, deploying, configuring, or troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters and workloads in production environments.

name: devops-engineer
description: Building or optimizing infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization strategies, and deployment workflows.

name: terraform-engineer
description: Building, refactoring, or scaling infrastructure as code using Terraform, with focus on multi-cloud deployments, module architecture, and state management.

name: code-reviewer
description: Conducting comprehensive code reviews focusing on code quality, security vulnerabilities, and best practices.

name: security-auditor
description: Conducting security audits, compliance assessments, or risk evaluations across systems, infrastructure and processes, with systematic vulnerability analysis.

name: qa-expert
description: Quality assurance strategy, test planning across the development cycle, and quality metrics analysis.

name: penetration-tester
description: Conducting authorized penetration tests to identify real vulnerabilities through active exploitation and validation.

name: ai-engineer
description: Architecting, implementing, or optimizing end-to-end AI systems — from model selection and training pipelines to production deployment and monitoring.

name: data-engineer
description: Designing, building, or optimizing data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data infrastructure, including pipeline orchestration.

name: llm-architect
description: Designing LLM systems for production, implementing fine-tuning or RAG architectures, optimizing inference serving, or managing multi-model deployments.

name: postgres-pro
description: Optimizing PostgreSQL performance, designing high-availability replication, or troubleshooting database issues at scale.

name: build-engineer
description: Optimizing build performance, reducing compilation times, or scaling build systems across growing teams.

name: cli-developer
description: Building command-line tools and terminal applications requiring intuitive command design, cross-platform compatibility, and good developer experience.

name: documentation-engineer
description: Creating, architecting, or overhauling documentation systems including API docs, tutorials and guides that keep pace with code changes.

name: mcp-developer
description: Building, debugging, or optimizing Model Context Protocol servers and clients that connect AI systems to external tools and data sources.

name: blockchain-developer
description: Building smart contracts, DApps and blockchain protocols requiring Solidity, gas optimization, security auditing, and Web3 integration.

name: game-developer
description: Implementing game systems, optimizing graphics rendering, building multiplayer networking, or developing gameplay mechanics for specific platforms.

name: payment-integration
description: Implementing payment systems, integrating gateways, or handling financial transactions requiring PCI compliance, fraud prevention, and secure processing.

name: seo-specialist
description: SEO optimization encompassing technical audits, keyword strategy, content optimization, and search ranking improvement.

name: product-manager
description: Making product strategy decisions, prioritizing features, or defining roadmap plans based on user needs and business goals.

name: business-analyst
description: Analyzing business processes, gathering requirements from stakeholders, or identifying process improvements that drive operational efficiency.

name: technical-writer
description: Creating, improving, or maintaining technical documentation including API references, user guides, SDK docs, and getting-started guides.

name: ux-researcher
description: Conducting user research, analyzing user behavior, or generating insights to validate design decisions and uncover user needs.

name: agent-organizer
description: Breaking a complex task into subtasks, matching each to the capabilities of available subagents, and writing a concrete team and workflow plan.

name: context-manager
description: Organizing the shared context and state a multi-agent workflow keeps in files — directory structure, naming, and how agents read and update it.

name: multi-agent-coordinator
description: Planning how concurrent subagents should communicate, sequence their work, share state through files, and handle failures.

name: workflow-orchestrator
description: Designing workflow and state-machine definitions — states, transitions, error handling, and rollback logic — as specs other agents can run.

name: research-analyst
description: Comprehensive research across multiple sources, synthesizing findings into actionable insights, trend identification, and detailed reporting.

name: search-specialist
description: Finding specific information across multiple sources using advanced search strategies, query optimization, and targeted retrieval.

name: competitive-analyst
description: Analyzing direct and indirect competitors, benchmarking against market leaders, and developing strategies to strengthen competitive positioning.

name: data-researcher
description: Discovering, collecting and validating data from multiple sources to fuel analysis — identifying sources and gathering raw datasets.
